note: A mailbox in the shape of the owner's: raw sender, subject, first lines and the Authentication-Results header, anonymised. `employer` is the verified employer's domain when the person follows one. Each mail carries what code must conclude. This is a fixture; S8 and S9 are measured on the owner's own mailbox once it is granted.
